title: Lower layer super output areas, December 2021 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped, v5)
description: Lower layer super output areas as published for December 2021, covering England and Wales. Generalised to 20 m and clipped to the coastline. Version 5 of the release. The publisher's file gives the Welsh name of the 41 Isle of Anglesey areas as Ynys Mfn rather than Ynys Môn; names are kept as published.
